convert_json_to_txt: convert a COCO-style JSON file with images and annotations into a plain text file with image names and labels
run_gen_lists: run the script to convert iNaturalist18 train and val JSON files into text list files
refactor_convert_function: refactor the convert function to accept a configurable root path via command-line arguments
review_convert_function: review the convert function that reads JSON images and annotations and writes paired image-label lines to a text file
summarize_gen_lists: summarize the script that iterates over a JSON-to-text mapping and converts each JSON file to a labeled text list
